Nightwave Plaza

An online vaporwave radio whose player is a Windows 9x desktop over a faded anime still of stacked CRT computers.

Source
plaza.one
Style
Vaporwave (agent-proposed, not yet reviewed by a person)
Moods
Nostalgic, calm, hazy
Evidence
Captured with tools/capture.mjs (headless Chrome, 1440 × 900) on 28 September 2026 and inspected. The screenshot shows the first viewport; the measurement covers up to four screens.
Reviewed
28 September 2026
Rights
Third-party work, stored with credit for commentary. License: unverified. Rights policy

Observed

  • The background is a muted anime still of stacked beige computer units and CRT monitors, one labelled TOSHIBA EX-500, with orange, pink, and teal screens showing large pixel characters.
  • A grey Windows 9x player window with Play and like buttons and a pink checkered album thumbnail sits in the centre, partly covered by a News dialog with a navy title bar and a Close button.
  • A grey Windows 9x taskbar runs along the bottom with task buttons and a clock.

Why it belongs

The measurement finds hard shadows on 56% of boxes with a 1.4 px median offset and zero radius: the same bevel values as Agora Road. The pastel colour is all in the background image, so gradient share is 0.

Borrow

Put a faded, low-contrast image behind crisp, unfaded Windows 9x windows; the contrast between the two keeps the text readable.
